opportunities.title: Your Coldcard Seed Wasn't Random Enough — Here's the Fix That Came $130M Too Late
opportunities.why_now: Coldcard just shipped a firmware patch to strengthen seed generation days after reports tie it to a $114–130M theft, and CoinDesk confirms AI helped surface the bugs.
opportunities.angle: Technical explainer: what was actually wrong with entropy generation, what the patch changes, and a checklist for hardware wallet holders to verify their seed was generated safely — no hype, just 'do this now' guidance.

opportunities.title: 885,000 Phone Numbers Just Got Mapped to Crypto Wallets — Here's What That Actually Means
opportunities.why_now: A cybersecurity firm just disclosed a phishing campaign targeting nearly a million phone numbers, a scale that suggests industrialized SIM-swap/social-engineering infrastructure, not a one-off scam.
opportunities.angle: Breakdown of the attack chain (data source → SMS/voice phishing → wallet drain), practical defense steps (2FA hardening, number portability locks), and why 'it won't happen to me' is exactly what the last 885,000 people thought.

opportunities.title: AI Crime in Crypto Is Up 40% — And the People Fighting Back Are Using the Same Tools
opportunities.why_now: TRM Labs just quantified a 40% YoY rise in AI-assisted crypto crime the same week Decrypt profiled a red-team group using AI to find bugs in Bitcoin software before attackers do.
opportunities.angle: Dueling-AI feature: pair the TRM stat with the red-team story to frame 2026 as the year attacker and defender tooling converged — end with what this means for anyone still trusting 'audited' as a safety label.

opportunities.title: Bitcoin Ripped to $80K This Week. Three Chains Got Robbed While Nobody Was Watching.
opportunities.why_now: Amid the biggest weekly BTC gain in two years, Sandbox halted bridging after an exploit, BounceBit is abandoning its own chain after a $3M hack, and Mantra halted entirely — all in the same 48 hours.
opportunities.angle: Contrarian roundup for the 'already priced' voice: euphoria and exploits aren't opposites, they're correlated — bull markets are when security debt gets called in. Frame as a pattern-recognition piece, not a hot take.

opportunities.title: Zcash Just Hit an 8-Year High Because Everyone Suddenly Remembered Bitcoin Isn't Private
opportunities.why_now: ZEC surged 48% to $850 with $10B in futures volume as Grayscale's spot ETF filing advances — a privacy-coin rally happening in plain sight of chain-analysis firms and regulators.
opportunities.angle: Security-market crossover piece: what a Zcash ETF actually means for on-chain surveillance economics, and why the same institutions buying transparency-friendly BTC ETFs are now chasing the opposite trade.
